test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** "unavoidable​."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes a situation where floods have always been an inevitable part of life as we know it on Earth.
 
• "Unavoidable" means that it cannot be avoided or prevented. (जिससे बचना या जिसे रोकना संभव न हो; अपरिहार्य, अनिवार्य)
 
 
• Example:* War is now **unavoidable**__.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2."
 
• Correct passage:

A flood occurs when water overflows its natural __barriers__ and lands on typically dry ground. Floods have always been an __**unavoidable**__ component of life on the planet. A legend about a ______ (3) ______ flood exists in almost every civilisation. Many people have ______ (4) ______ to live near bodies of water in order to have access to transportation routes, fishing, and water for drinking, farming, and industry. The majority of the world's major cities are ______ (5) ______ on or near oceans, lakes, or rivers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Looking at other options:

 
 
• **Evitable: **able to be avoided or prevented; avoidable. (टालने या रोकने में सक्षम; टालने योग्य)
 
• **Amendable: **happy to accept something; willing to be influenced by somebody/something. (ख़ुशी से स्‍वीकार करने वाला; स्‍वेच्‍छा से प्रभावित होने वाला)
 
• **Accessible: **possible to be reached or entered. (जहाँ पहुँचना या प्रवेश करना संभव हो; सुगम)
